nodes.name: Daily Schedule
nodes.notes: Runs every day at 06:00 server time. Edit the cron expression to change the schedule.

nodes.name: Build 30 Queries
nodes.notes: Edit the `domains` and `brands` arrays to match your setup. Generates one item per (brand × domain) pair with the target Google Sheets cell pre-computed.

nodes.name: Loop Over Queries
nodes.notes: Processes one query at a time so the Wait node can throttle per-request.

nodes.name: XMLStock API
nodes.notes: Calls XMLStock Yandex XML endpoint. Credentials come from env vars XMLSTOCK_USER and XMLSTOCK_KEY. Response is raw XML.

nodes.name: Parse XML
nodes.notes: Converts XMLStock XML response to JSON. The `data` field of the previous HTTP node holds the raw XML body.

nodes.name: Extract Found Count
nodes.notes: Reads <found> value from parsed XML. Writes `ERR` to the sheet if XMLStock returned an error or the response was malformed — check the `error` field in execution logs.

nodes.name: Throttle 2.5s
nodes.notes: Sleeps 2.5 seconds between requests to stay under XMLStock rate limits.

nodes.name: Write Cell to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Updates a single cell via the Sheets API (values.update). Uses the n8n Google Sheets OAuth2 credential — you MUST bind an existing credential after import.
